[ndma_coldwave_03] ## Elderly and Children Care
- Keep room temperature comfortable for elderly citizens, newborn babies, and heart patients.
- Contact national emergency helpline 112 or local disaster management helpline 1077 for shelter assistance.
- Key terms: बुजुर्ग, नवजात शिशु, रैन बसेरा, वृद्धांची काळजी, వృద్ధులు మరియు పిల్లలు, elderly care, newborn, shelter, 112, 1077.

[ndma_coldwave_02] ## Don'ts During Cold Wave
- Do not drink alcohol, as it dilates blood vessels and lowers your core body temperature rapidly despite a false sensation of warmth.
- Avoid prolonged exposure to cold winds and damp conditions to prevent frostbite and hypothermia.
- Do not ignore shivering; persistent shivering is the first warning sign of body heat loss and hypothermia.
- Do not massage frostbitten areas with snow or rub vigorously, as this causes severe tissue damage. Seek immediate medical attention.
- Key terms: शराब का सेवन, फ्रॉस्टबाइट, हाइपोथर्मिया, थंडी वाऱ्यापासून बचाव, frostbite, shivering, alcohol, hypothermia.

[icar_agriculture_advisory_03] ## Frost and Cold Wave Crop Protection
- Provide light irrigation to fields during the late evening prior to cold wave nights; moist soil retains and radiates heat better than dry soil, protecting plants from ground frost.
- Create light smokiness (smudging) along orchard borders using moist biomass on calm frosty nights to raise boundary temperatures.
- For crop-specific advice and pest management, farmers can contact the national Kisan Call Centre toll-free at 1800-180-1551.
